blurb:
Join us on the East Village Food Tour and explore one of NYC’s most vibrant neighborhoods while trying a mix of NYC classics, authentic immigrant foods, and unique local favorites.

What’s included?
- 7 food tastings included in the price featuring bagels, pizza, pierogi, empanadas, mac & cheese, donuts, and more

- Explore iconic East Village locations, hidden side streets, music venues, bars, and street art

- Learn about the neighborhood’s immigrant history, punk rock roots, and food culture

About The Neighborhood
The East Village is one of NYC’s most diverse neighborhoods, shaped by generations of immigrants, artists, and musicians. On this tour, you’ll eat your way through the neighborhood while learning about the local stories and history.

About Us
This is a brand new tour from Tasty Tours NYC, New York’s top-rated food tour company. Our mission is to make sure you have an awesome experience and get a real taste of everything the Big Apple has to offer.
